text:
Jun (oncall): @here automated alerts just flagged region-level failures for us-west1 — multiple AZs showing healthcheck failures and provider reports a regional networking issue. starting triage. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/region-outage
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0423-WEST1 | severity: potential-sev1 | affected: hosted inference / dedicated pools in us-west1 | alert_sources: provider, lb, probe-synthetics
Priya (eng-infra): seeing same in metrics — control-plane API 503s from us-west1, instance termination storms in us-west1-a/b/c, reconciler errors spiking. reserved dedicated pool for corp-customers shows 0 healthy nodes.
Mateo (eng-runtime): GPU hosts are flapping; some nodes still reachable but KV cache lost for ~80% of sessions. scheduler reports pod evictions due to network overlay errors. posting `kubectl get pods -n inference --all-namespaces --selector=region=us-west1` output: `Error from server: Get "https://...": dial tcp: i/o timeout`
Emily (eng-sre): I’ll cut traffic away from us-west1 now. plan: 1) shift 75% write+inference traffic to us-west2, 25% to nyc1 as warm standby; 2) lower DNS TTL to 30s; 3) enable model-variant fallback (quantized-llama-1) to reduce memory pressure. executing step 1 via LB weights now.
Priya (eng-infra): confirmed autoscaler also failing in region — don’t rely on automatic replacement yet. we should disable cross-region autoscaling until provider stabilizes to avoid thrash.
Liam (support): customers on reserved Dedicated in us-west1 are reporting errors. pushing support template now to affected customers and offering reroute instructions. template: "We detected a provider-level networking issue in us-west1 and are shifting traffic to alternate regions; minimal disruption expected. We’ll follow up with ETA once provider confirms restoration."
Mateo (eng-runtime): implementing fallback config: toggling `enable_quantized_fallback=true` for routes in us-west1 to reduce OOM retries. issuing config change: `infractl route update --route inference --region us-west1 --fallback quantized`
Jun (oncall): ops note: do not perform destructive maintenance in us-west1 until provider acknowledges region is readable. any remediation should be staged in us-west2/nyc1 first.
Priya (eng-infra): running provider CLI to pull instance state: `provider-cli list-instances --region us-west1 --filter health!=HEALTHY` -> ~124 instances unhealthy, TCP probe failures across nodes. opening ticket with provider now and attaching logs. ticket id: PROV-87921.
Emily (eng-sre): traffic shift in progress — so far 68% of inference traffic rerouted. latency on us-west2 increased ~40ms median, error rate stabilized. watch for token cost bump from cache misses. setting alert: error_rate_global > 3% for 5m -> pager.
Mateo (eng-runtime): KV cache miss rate jumped x5 after shift — warming in progress. suggestion: pre-warm top 200 prompt prefixes in us-west2 overnight job. kicking prewarm job now.
Liam (support): updating incident channel with customer-facing note. collecting list of customers pinned to us-west1 reserved capacity for post-mortem.
ops-bot: PROVIDER TICKET UPDATE: PROV-87921 | provider says "network control plane degraded; working on region fabric" | ETA unknown | will update.
Priya (eng-infra): because dedicated pools are impacted, we need to failover some committed workloads to Private deployments if customers allow — contacting account owners for migration approvals.
Jun (oncall): declaring SEV1 for infra, creating incident bridge. bridge: https://redwood/bridges/INC-2026-0423-WEST1 | attendees: eng-infra, eng-sre, eng-runtime, support, product.
Emily (eng-sre): immediate next steps checklist: 1) continue traffic weights to <10% to us-west1, 2) enable fallback models across affected routes, 3) monitor provider ticket, 4) communicate to customers every 30m. will send first status update in 10m.
Mateo (eng-runtime): noted cost impact: cross-region egress and cache misses will increase token/unit cost. ops: estimate +15-30% for duration. logging for finance.
Priya (eng-infra): posted provider-supplied troubleshooting hints to bridge, attempting control-plane proxy workaround to reattach some nodes (low chance).
Liam (support): queued post to status.redwood.ai with initial statement. will patch with ETA when provider responds.
Jun (oncall): thanks all. keep updates short — use threads for deep debugging. next update in ~8 minutes or on significant change. :white_check_mark:
